source: DELF Prim A1 (France Éducation International). DELF Prim publishes no closed word list; every word is in the derived DELF Prim word list (content/src/fr/WORDLIST.md, npm run content:wordlist -- fr) at level A1 or A1.1: lemmas attested in the child-facing text of the A1 sample papers (delf-prim-a1-livret-candidat, -transcription, -livret-examinateur: hobbies and dislikes, school subjects, seasons, a birthday card, a class trip to a farm, a ski week, a countryside invitation, a cafeteria role play, a music festival, the job of a parent, how the child comes to school), completed per theme with everyday child words (source topic) and with concepts of Cambridge Movers (source parity). Grammar: the present of regular and common irregular verbs (aller, faire, venir, pouvoir, vouloir, devoir, savoir, prendre), reflexive verbs as the papers use them (nous nous levons), prepositions of place, all possessives, numbers to 100, the time, il fait + weather, months and dates. Dutch translations written by the content author.
